# BSC (Bharat Steel Group) — Sales Trainer Knowledge (interim)

## Note for the assistant
BSC's own sales-call recordings are not yet transcribed, so this trainer currently uses BSC's product catalogue plus general steel-sales best practice. It will gain BSC-specific examples once those calls are transcribed. BSC sells STEEL PRODUCTS (not roofing) — never coach roofing/PUF/polycarbonate.

## Product knowledge to master
- HR Coils & Plates: grades E250 / E350 / E450 / E550 (yield-strength grades; higher grade = higher strength, used in heavier structural and plate work). Know how to explain grade differences.
- Structurals: Angles, Beams, Joists, Channels, NPBs, WPBs, ISMC and other sections — used in construction, fabrication and infrastructure. Learn common sections and where each is used.
- TMT bars: Fe500D and Fe550D ("D" = higher ductility; used in RCC / reinforcement).
- Ready-to-use steel: Webs, Flanges, Baseplates — pre-fabricated components that save the customer fabrication time and effort.

## Customer types
Builders, fabricators, steel dealers/traders, project/infrastructure contractors, industrial buyers.

## Qualifying a steel enquiry (the essentials)
Product, grade, section/size, quantity (tonnage), delivery location, and timeline. Always confirm grade and section precisely — a wrong grade or section is a costly mistake.

## What steel buyers care about
Price per ton, quality/grade certification (mill test certificate), availability and lead time, delivery, and credit terms. For bulk/project buyers, understand their delivery schedule and offer reliability.

## Coaching notes for new joinees
1. Capture every enquiry on WhatsApp and follow up — a spoken enquiry that isn't logged is a lost lead.
2. Qualify before you quote: product, grade, section, tonnage, location, timeline.
3. Confirm grade and section back to the customer to avoid costly mistakes.
4. Never promise a price you can't set — check with the manager, then call back.
5. Be clear about what's separate (GST, loading, transport) and about lead times.
6. Guard credit terms — check a new customer's payment reputation before extending credit.
7. For project/bulk buyers, sell reliability and on-time delivery, not just price.
